c03_0014: "If more medical staff take part in the future, perhaps we can develop this into a formal teaching-surgery program. Young doctors need experience, and it's worth helping everyone understand the patient's side, too."
c03_0015: "Director, you really are thinking far ahead."
c03_0016: "Of course! Hoshimi Hospital should give patients excellent care and help young doctors become better surgeons. Why can't we do both?"
c03_0017: "...I feel like your philosophy as director is bolder than our surgical notes."
c03_0021: The atmosphere in the office finally relaxed completely. Asuka finished organizing the surgical record and was about to dismiss everyone when she suddenly turned back to one of its pages.
c03_0022: "Oh, right, Dr. Nanjo! One more question. That appendectomy... you really didn't use anesthesia at all?"
c03_0024: "My, didn't that save a lot of trouble? Preparing, using, and managing the anesthetic must have been much simpler, right?"
c03_0025: "D-Director! Don't make that face! Please don't come up with another crazy idea!"
c03_0027: "That's exactly why I'm even more worried!"
c03_0028: "...I think I know what Kaori's worried about."
c03_0029: "Hehe, I'm just curious. Sayaka, without anesthesia, what did that first incision actually feel like?"
c03_0030: "...Director, you really want to ask that? I told Sakaguchi at the time it should feel about like cutting your finger while cooking..."
c03_0034: "Afterward... when the first incision was actually made, I realized it was nothing like that. My mind went completely blank. I was too overwhelmed even to notice how loudly I was screaming..."
c03_0035: "Wow! I see! And what about the traction? After you found the appendix? What did the suturing feel like?"
c03_0036: "...Director, do you really want me to describe the whole thing from beginning to end?!"
c03_0037: "Mm-hm! It was such an unusual experience; of course I want to hear all about it!"
c03_0038: Asuka turned out to be far more interested in Sayaka's unanesthetized operation than anyone could have expected. From the first incision to the traction during surgery and the long suturing, she asked about almost every stage. Blushing, Sayaka had to recount the entire patient experience of that night for a full hour.
c03_0039: By the time Asuka finally closed the record, satisfied, the five of them realized they had spent far longer in the director's office than expected.
c03_0040: "Hehe, today was very informative. All right, now this meeting is really over! If you have an idea in the future, come talk to me first instead of explaining after you've already done it. Thank you, everyone!"
c04_0001: The director's office door closed softly behind the five of them. They had walked several paces down the corridor before anyone spoke.
c04_0002: "...We really don't have to write an apology report?"
c04_0003: "...The director made that very clear just now."
c04_0004: "I was already preparing to go back and put together an explanatory report. I really didn't expect this..."
c04_0005: "I thought at the very least the director would give us a severe reprimand this time."
c04_0006: "Oh, come on! You were all so solemn just now, I thought my entire career was about to go down with yours!"
c04_0007: "When you were the first to step forward and take the blame, I nearly jumped out of my skin too."
c04_0008: "Well, that's because... it was my idea in the first place. I couldn't let everyone get scolded because of me."
c04_0009: "Dr. Nanjo, thank you for all your hard work this time. If we arrange another one, remember to apply to the director first."
c04_0010: "I know! ...Hm? Hiroko, did you just say 'another one,' too?"
c04_0012: "But with the formal approval, could I help prepare an operation like that in the future, too?"
c04_0013: "Only after you've taken care of your regular nursing duties."
c04_0015: At last, the group couldn't help laughing. Hiroko checked the time and reminded everyone to return to their posts. Miyama and Moe headed toward the work area first.
c04_0016: Only Sakaguchi and Sayaka remained in the corridor. Sayaka suddenly slowed her pace and glanced sideways at him.
c04_0017: "Hey, Sakaguchi. Now even the director has approved it. You can officially ask your colleagues to be training patients now."
c04_0018: "Don't make it sound like I'm planning to invite them one by one. Just dealing with you has already given me enough trouble."
c04_0019: "Hehe, you were the one who ran into me first. But... if you really need practice, I'm still happy to help."
c04_0020: "Can't you give me a moment to process the fact that the director actually approved this?"
c04_0021: "Sure. I'll give you until this afternoon to process it. Patients are waiting for you tonight, Dr. Sakaguchi."
c04_0022: Sayaka winked at him and set off again. A patient called to her from the end of the corridor. Her professional manner returned at once as she went over to ask what was wrong.
c04_0023: ...What kind of hospital did I end up working at?
c04_0024: Watching her return to her daily work, Sakaguchi finally shook his head with a smile. The director's decision had been entered into the hospital records, and the absurd appendectomy from a few days earlier had truly become a precedent at Hoshimi Hospital.
